summary.text: Angela Coburn is the Democratic candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 27, and a member of the West Warwick Public Schools school board, representing Ward 5 since 2021.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026, and faces Republican Lawrence Almagno in the November 3, 2026 general election.
